advice_items.quote: Health is wealth. It really is.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize your health because physical well-being is true wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 健康就是真正的财富

advice_items.quote: The most important thing in life is about taking shots. You take a lot of risks.
advice_items.summary_en: Take bold shots and calculated risks throughout your career.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人生最重要的是敢于冒险出手

advice_items.quote: The most important thing is you have to have a partner who's with you all the way.
advice_items.summary_en: Having a committed life partner who stands by you is essential.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择全力支持你的人生伴侣

advice_items.quote: The most valuable piece of real estate is in graveyards because there's billion-dollar ideas in the ground of people that never took action.
advice_items.summary_en: Act on your business ideas now rather than taking unexecuted ideas to the grave.
advice_items.summary_zh: 有想法要立刻行动，莫留终身遗憾

advice_items.quote: No is halfway to yes. Take that to the bank.
advice_items.summary_en: Welcome rejection and treat every 'no' as halfway to a 'yes'.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把每次拒绝都视为成功的一半

advice_items.quote: We're not all defined by material things. It's really what are you made of.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on your inner character and resilience rather than material possessions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人的价值在于内在品格而非物质

advice_items.quote: Don't take no for an answer, man. Believe in yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: Believe in yourself relentlessly and refuse to accept no for an answer.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定自信，无视质疑与否定

guests.first_money_or_break: 18岁开始创业，深耕健身与健康领域，创立Fit TV电视网并以超1亿美元出售给新闻集团（News Corp）。
guests.role_or_title: Fitness & Health Entrepreneur / Fit TV Founder
guests.wealth_detail: Sold Fit TV to News Corp for over $100M
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要接受“不”的回答，坚定相信自己；有想法就立刻行动，别等老了留下遗憾，把每次拒绝当作通往成功的阶梯。

advice_items.quote: I found a way to mirror my passion and make a little money doing it, too. I love what I do.
advice_items.summary_en: Align your business and investments with work you genuinely love.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将热爱与赚钱的事业结合起来

advice_items.quote: It's three things really: people, processes, or profitability. Most companies have two out of three; if I can add value, then you get me.
advice_items.summary_en: Evaluate businesses on people, processes, and profitability, and invest where you can add the missing piece.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资看重人、流程与盈利三要素

advice_items.quote: The world crashed, pandemic... and we just doubled down. When everybody's fearful, that's the time to jump in.
advice_items.summary_en: Double down and seize opportunities when everyone else is fearful during downturns.
advice_items.summary_zh: 市场低迷众人恐惧时果断加倍下注

advice_items.quote: You don't have to be the smartest person in the room... put all y'all together and I'm going to speak last.
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with the smartest people, let them contribute first, and speak last.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重用比你更聪明的人才并虚心倾听

advice_items.quote: I had to be strong enough to understand that not everybody's going to see my vision.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay committed to your vision even when family and peers doubt you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 屏蔽质疑声音，坚定自己的愿景

guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家，收购并经营高等职业院校（位于加州卡尔斯巴德的Theora Technical College），并在疫情低谷期逆势加倍投资，单年最高赚取约1700万美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 在众人恐惧时果断入场；用人、流程、盈利三要素评估企业并补足短板；凝聚比自己更聪明的人共事并最后发言。

advice_items.quote: We were crazy hard workers.
advice_items.summary_en: Work relentlessly hard rather than relying on luck alone.
advice_items.summary_zh: 成功的背后是近乎疯狂的努力

advice_items.quote: Just keep your eyes open. Read a lot, talk to people, network, but just read a lot, think a lot.
advice_items.summary_en: Read voraciously, think deeply, and stay observant to spot winning products.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持敏锐观察，大量阅读与深入思考

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: The more competitive something is, that means there's an opportunity. The best place to put a gas station is next to another gas station.
advice_items.summary_en: Enter competitive markets because high competition proves strong demand and opportunity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于进入高竞争市场寻找大机会

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Differentiate With a Unique Product Angle
advice_items.quote: There's a million guys selling the same nonsense. You have to find something different.
advice_items.summary_en: Stand out in crowded markets by finding a unique product or selling angle.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造差异化产品，避免同质化竞争

advice_items.quote: Keep your eyes open. Keep thinking big. Think big and never ever, no matter what, quit.
advice_items.summary_en: Think big, stay alert to opportunities, and never quit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于格局放大，无论如何绝不放弃

advice_items.quote: Don't ever quit. We've been punched in the head so many times it's not even funny.
advice_items.summary_en: Endure repeated setbacks and keep pushing forward without quitting.
advice_items.summary_zh: 承受反复打击依然坚持前行

guests.first_money_or_break: 从事健康产品推广与营销，1998年推出首款草本伟哥并成为GNC史上最畅销产品，后布局远程医疗业务，巅峰单年收入达数亿美元。
guests.wealth_detail: Hundreds of millions of dollars in a single year
guests.zero_start_advice: 保持高强度努力与观察力，大量阅读并多与人交流；不惧怕竞争激烈的市场，关键在于找到差异化的独特产品；格局放大，永不放弃。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: You can get rich by following a trend. You can get wealthy by creating a trend.
advice_items.summary_en: Create or get ahead of emerging industry trends like cybersecurity or AI to build true wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应趋势能致富，引领趋势成巨富

advice_items.quote: Nothing changes unless you change. If you're not willing to do something different today, you're going to lead the life you had yesterday.
advice_items.summary_en: Take different actions today if you want your life and financial situation to change.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不做出改变，生活就永远原地踏步

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: It's very hard to get wealthy making a big income. You got to have capital gains. You got to build something of value that you can sell.
advice_items.summary_en: Build sellable equity and capital gains rather than relying solely on high annual income.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠高薪难成巨富，必须打造可出售股权

advice_items.quote: The difference between successful people and others is how long they wallow in misery... 5 minutes later, I just got to get up and do it again.
advice_items.summary_en: Minimize how long you dwell on setbacks and get right back up to keep going.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别沉溺痛苦太久，跌倒后迅速起身

advice_items.quote: Never sell a house. Always keep every house... if you can hang on to a property for 10 years, for sure you'll make money.
advice_items.summary_en: Buy real estate and hold properties for at least 10 years without selling prematurely.
advice_items.summary_zh: 买下房产长期持有十年以上切勿轻卖

advice_items.quote: Biggest mistake people make in sales is they have a pitch and they apply that pitch to every single person... Before you sell, find out the need.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop using a generic pitch; learn who the buyer is and uncover their specific need first.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售前先洞察客户需求，切忌套用话术

advice_items.quote: If you don't know anybody, you got to become the person other people want to know... provide something of value.
advice_items.summary_en: Become someone successful people want to know by delivering value and building your reputation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先创造价值，让自己成为值得结交的人

advice_items.quote: Motivation is easy. Passion is easy. But all that stuff fades. Obsession lasts.
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate deep obsession with your craft, because motivation and passion fade while obsession endures.
advice_items.summary_zh: 激情会消退，唯有极度执着才能持久

advice_items.quote: The biggest flex of wealth today is being in shape... If you're not using your money to stay healthy, what's the point?
advice_items.summary_en: Invest your time and resources into staying physically fit, as health is the ultimate flex.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持身材与健康才是财富最大的炫耀

advice_items.quote: If you have no money, e-commerce... It depends on your brand. I think it's easy to build a brand today online.
advice_items.summary_en: Start with low-capital e-commerce and build a strong online brand if you lack starting money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没本钱可从电商切入打造线上品牌

advice_items.quote: A great person can make a bad idea good. A bad person can take a great business and completely screw it up.
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on exceptional people rather than ideas, since A-players elevate any business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投人胜过投点子，优秀人才可化腐朽

advice_items.quote: Beware the man in the t-shirt because that guy worked his ass off to a point that he can wear whatever he want. He doesn't have to dress to impress.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid dressing or spending to impress others; build real leverage so people come to you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别靠名牌撑门面，实力够强无需讨好

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Train Custom AI on Your Workflow
advice_items.quote: Train your AI model to the way you work. So, we spent a lot of time training our version of AI to write like me.
advice_items.summary_en: Customize and train AI tools on your personal style and workflows for business leverage.
advice_items.summary_zh: 按个人工作方式训练专属AI提升效率

advice_items.quote: Sell joy... It's not what you say, it's how you make people feel. The less you have, the nicer and the more engaging you have to be.
advice_items.summary_en: Win clients over by selling joy, warmth, and making people feel great when dealing with you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 向客户传递快乐与好感，重视情绪价值

advice_items.quote: You'll never find anything in life as fascinating as another human being. And I'm deeply Christian and so I try to approach every human being that way.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and approach every person with genuine curiosity about their story.
advice_items.summary_zh: 怀抱信仰与好奇心真诚对待每个人

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身贫寒随父母偷渡到加拿大，21岁投身当时尚存质疑的互联网与网络安全领域抢占先机，靠自身实力创造价值，最终出售公司单年斩获约5亿美元（含资本利得）。
guests.role_or_title: Cybersecurity & AI Entrepreneur / Shark Tank Investor
guests.wealth_detail: $500M highest single-year total (including business sale capital gains); ~$18M/yr income
guests.zero_start_advice: 若保留人脉从零开始会创立AI公司（看好AI数据基础设施）；若完全无资金则从电商切入打造线上品牌，通过提供价值和积极情绪赢得客户与人脉。
